newDialog.title: New ledger
newDialog.description: A separate set of books. Choose a base currency now — every transaction you log here is stored in this currency. You can rename and recolor later.
newDialog.name: Name
newDialog.namePlaceholder: Studio · Side hustle · Trip to Japan…
newDialog.taglinePlaceholder: One-line description shown in the switcher

txnSheet.title: Transaction details
txnSheet.description: View and edit the selected transaction.

add.sheetDescription: Record an expense, income, or transfer.
add.duplicateWarning: Possible duplicate — {merchant} for the same amount on this account around {date}. Save again only if it's a separate purchase.

ledger.baseCurrencyHint: Reporting currency for this ledger. Changing it rewrites every locked conversion in {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}} using the rate on each transaction's own date.
ledger.baseCurrencyToastDescription: {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}} reconverted.
ledger.lastLedgerHint: You can't delete the only ledger. Create another first.

baseChangeDialog.title: Change base currency to {currency}?
baseChangeDialog.description: Every locked amount_base in this ledger ({count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}) will be re-converted under the new base, using the rate on each transaction's own date. Account balances are then re-derived. Reversible by switching back.

editDialog.title: Edit ledger
editDialog.description: Rename, recolor, or rewrite the tagline. Base currency is changed separately (it rewrites every locked conversion).
editDialog.name: Name
editDialog.taglinePlaceholder: One-line description shown in the switcher

deleteDialog.title: Delete "{name}"?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes the ledger and everything in it: {accounts, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}}, {txns, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}, and every budget, scheduled item, rule, holding, receipt, and category scoped to it. Not recoverable unless you restore from a backup.

bottomBar.hint: Choose and reorder the four sections in your bottom navigation. The center Add button is always shown.

data.hint: Your changes are saved on this device. Reset restores the original sample data.

importDb.label: Import database
importDb.dialogDescription: Your data lives in a SQLite file on the server and syncs on every change. Importing replaces it. A snapshot of the current DB is saved first so you can undo this.

restore.dialogDescription: Replaces the current database with the contents of this backup. A snapshot of the live DB is created first so you can undo this.
restore.dialogDescriptionDetail: Restoring {name} ({date} · {size}) will replace your current database. A snapshot of the current state will be saved automatically before the swap.

importDialog.description: This will replace your current database with the contents of {name}. A backup of your current data will be saved automatically before the swap.
importDialog.fileSize: File size: {size}. The file is validated (SQLite header, schema version, foreign keys, checksum) before it replaces your live database.

backup.hint: Your data lives in a SQLite file on the server and syncs on every change. Importing replaces the live file — a snapshot of the current state is saved automatically before the swap.
